sources.use: Frozen CMS field shape, current Chinese route keys, locale, launch state, robots, and 5×6 taxonomy labels.
sources.limitation: The existing short body copy is an input to audit, not an authority for new academic claims.

sources.use: Non-diagnostic, non-deterministic, non-screening public claim boundaries.
Frozen V2 public route family and duplicate-route boundary.

sources.title: NEO Facets Table
sources.author_or_source: International Personality Item Pool, Oregon Research Institute
sources.claim: Documents corresponding IPIP scales for the 30 NEO-PI-R facet constructs.
sources.limitation: IPIP scales measure similar constructs; this does not make them identical to proprietary NEO scales or authorize score conversion.

sources.title: The next Big Five Inventory (BFI-2): Developing and assessing a hierarchical model with 15 facets
sources.author_or_source: Soto, C. J., & John, O. P.
sources.claim: Supports a hierarchical domain-and-facet reading of Big Five traits using 15 facets.
sources.limitation: BFI-2 has 15 facets, not the 30-facet taxonomy used for this CMS route set.

sources.title: Between facets and domains: 10 aspects of the Big Five
sources.author_or_source: DeYoung, C. G., Quilty, L. C., & Peterson, J. B.
sources.claim: Shows an alternative intermediate hierarchy with two aspects per domain.
sources.limitation: The ten aspects are not interchangeable with either BFI-2 facets or NEO/IPIP 30 facets.

sources.title: Paradigm Shift to the Integrative Big Five Trait Taxonomy: History, Measurement, and Conceptual Issues
sources.author_or_source: John, O. P., Naumann, L. P., & Soto, C. J.
sources.reference: In Handbook of Personality: Theory and Research (3rd ed.), pp. 114–158.
sources.claim: Supports broad Big Five taxonomy framing and continuous trait language.
sources.limitation: No individual prediction, numeric validity, or universal facet naming claim is taken from this review.

claim_map.claim: The six routes are narrower descriptors under conscientiousness, not six personality types.
Interest or attention in a facet is not equivalent to ability, diagnosis, or outcome prediction.
The route taxonomy must not be directly converted to BFI-2 facets or BFAS aspects.

competence.construct_summary: 对自己能否理解要求、组织行动并有效处理日常任务的通常把握感
competence.explicit_non_equivalence: 它不等于实际能力、智力、资历或自信口号。一个人可以能力很强但低估自己，也可以主观把握很高却缺少相关知识；能力仍需由具体任务证据判断

order.construct_summary: 对分类、安排、整洁、顺序和可预期工作结构的通常偏好程度
order.explicit_non_equivalence: 它不等于强迫症、洁癖、完美主义或工作质量。桌面整洁不能单独证明条理性，环境较乱也不代表不能交付；临床概念更不能由人格页面推断

dutifulness.construct_summary: 对承诺、职责、规则依据和他人合理期待的通常重视与履行倾向
dutifulness.explicit_non_equivalence: 它不等于服从权威、讨好、道德高低或永不拒绝。负责任也包括澄清不合理要求、保护自身边界和在条件变化时重新协商，而不是承担所有人的任务

achievement-striving.construct_summary: 为较高标准、进步目标和有挑战成果投入努力的通常倾向
achievement-striving.explicit_non_equivalence: 它不等于社会地位、收入、忙碌程度、内卷或最终成就。机会、资源、健康、照护责任与团队条件都会影响结果；追求较少也不代表懒惰或没有价值感

self-discipline.construct_summary: 在任务乏味、困难或回报延迟时启动行动并维持到合理完成点的通常倾向
self-discipline.explicit_non_equivalence: 它不等于道德意志、懒惰、执行功能诊断或永远高产。睡眠、压力、照护负担、环境摩擦与健康状态都会影响启动和坚持，不能由本页判断 ADHD 等临床问题

deliberation.construct_summary: 在行动或承诺前考虑后果、选项、风险与可逆性的通常倾向
deliberation.explicit_non_equivalence: 它不等于优柔寡断、焦虑、聪明程度或绝不冒险。审慎关注的是行动前权衡的习惯；考虑很多不保证结论正确，行动较快也不必然是冲动

limitations: The frozen CMS taxonomy is NEO/IPIP-like; it is not claimed as the single universal Big Five facet standard.
No proprietary assessment items, scoring keys, norms, or copyrighted manual text are reproduced.
No reliability, validity, percentile, clinical, hiring, admission, salary, relationship-outcome, or deterministic career claim is made.
GSC_EVIDENCE_PENDING: this package is content-authority preparation, not a search-performance claim.
